title: Unit Event — The Legend Still Vivid — Episode7 RAD WEEKEND

meta.Event Outline: Thanks to their experience of going camping together, VBS has learned the importance of having a shared vision when they sing. Kohane asks Taiga if there's a way for them to establish a shared vision of RAD WEEKEND without any footage of the event to go off of.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: This place is only supposed to fit about 300 people. Can we all really get in?

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line: Who knew that KEN and his crew would be putting on an event like this?

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: I know, right? Not just any event either. They wrangled up pretty much every active artist from around here.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (Hehe. That's my dad and his crew for you. Everyone's so anxious about seeing what's inside.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (Plus, they all seemed way more stoked than usual about putting on this event...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (I can't wait to see what it's like!)

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: Oh, looks like the doors are opening!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (Just at first glance, I know about 90% of the people here in the crowd.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (Is literally everyone from Vivid Street here?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
(Oh, there's Dad and the others!
Looks like they're heading backstage.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (They're usually totally pumped before the start of a show, but they seem kinda on edge for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Hm? Nagi's kicking things off by herself today?!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Yeah, where are KEN and Taiga at?
Doesn't RADder usually sing together to start a show?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (That's a really good question. What's going on here...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (They're never not together during these kinds of events...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(It's wall-to-wall with locals and regulars.
She doesn't have home-field advantage here...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (She just started singing, but the crowd's...!)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I'm giving this show absolutely everything I have!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: So try to keep up, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
I mean, she's always amazing...
But she's on a completely different level today...!!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Yeah, there we go!
You guys are awesome!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: The truth is that I want today to be the most important day of my life...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: We've put everything on the line for our music up to this point, and I'm sure you all know that...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
But today's different.
“Amazing” or “special” won't begin to describe what happens today.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Once in a lifetime... That's what this event's gonna be.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: So I want you guys to give us everything you've got!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: We're gonna make this night absolutely legendary, together!!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Next, we have RUST!
They're all yours!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (RUST's performing with their usual power, but they sound even better today for some reason! Like they're a whole different team...!)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
(Why is that...?
How are they able to sing like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Next is... GLaP day!!
Are you guys ready?! Let's hear it!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (It's not even a battle event, but it's like they're all trying to see who can really get the crowd going the most...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (My heart's gonna explode at this rate... It's like I'm seeing one headliner after another...!)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: And last but not least... Us!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah!! RADder!! The best comes last!!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
But are they gonna be okay?
I heard that KEN and Taiga have been fighting a lot lately. Enough to maybe even split up.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Those rumors might be true based on how they look now.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Get it together, boys.
Quit acting like grumpy old men.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Let's just try to have fun today, alright?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: And make this an unforgettable day...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (It's like a tsunami of notes is hitting us all at once...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
(The way they're singing...
They're sending us all sky high.)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: This is us! This is our song!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But you still have enough energy to complain.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Hehe...
This is why we're the best team!
